height = 0.75
n = 6
sections = []
for i in range(n):
    t = i / (n - 1)
    z = height * t
    x_off = 0.04 * t * t  # slight curve
    w = 0.06 - 0.02 * t  # taper
    d = 0.04 - 0.012 * t
    sections.append((z, x_off, w, d))

result = None
# Build lofted body through sections
wp = cq.Workplane("XY")
z0, x0, w0, d0 = sections[0]
wp = wp.center(x0, 0).rect(w0, d0)
prev_z, prev_x = z0, x0
for (z, x, w, d) in sections[1:]:
    wp = wp.workplane(offset=z - prev_z).center(x - prev_x, 0).rect(w, d)
    prev_z, prev_x = z, x
result = wp.loft(combine=True, ruled=False)
